ELITE.compositionNote: Elite Pools & Unified Portfolios continue to draw on PIMCO, Loomis Sayles and iAGAM as sub-advisors. This week brought the first dated, reactive sub-advisor data point in a while: PIMCO's flagship 60/40 fund is actively trimming Magnificent-Seven exposure for cheaper Asian AI-adjacent names (Bloomberg, Sep 4/26). The confirmed structural change at iAGAM itself stands: the Asset Allocation team that steers strategic/tactical tilts across these pools is now led by Tej Rai and Alex Bellefleur following Sébastien Mc Mahon's move to Chief Economist, iA Financial Group (effective May 19/26), with a related segregated-fund PM handover to the same pair reportedly effective Sep 14/26 (still unconfirmed by primary source). iA Clarington also continues to expand its broader active shelf (the Jul 27/26 International Multifactor Equity Fund launch) and is hosting an advisor event Sep 30-Oct 1/26 in Montreal with Elite Pools/Unified Portfolios content. No change to the Elite Portfolios' own strategic allocation targets was found as of today. This week's widened Iran-war escalation (direct US strikes across southern Iran, retaliation region-wide) and BoJ's near-certain September hike signal (see CCM5604) remain the most relevant live macro test for the fixed-income sub-advisors inside these pools.
